text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up: were running a staggered attestation + evidence check this week. If you have any data access (FT, PT, contractors) please: 1) complete the 10-min attestation; 2) attach or link required artifacts to the Evidence Vault; 3) mark assets with the evidence:done label. Windows by region: NA 04/10 EOD PT, EMEA 04/11 EOD CET, APAC 04/13 EOD SGT. Form + guide: https://redwood-internal.company/attest/staggered

Sam (Security): Well run a pattern scan after each regional window. Teams with >2 HIGH items will get manager escalation and a remediation ticket. We wont block deploys automatically, but repeated non-response may trigger temporary write restrictions for affected prefixes.

Olga (Legal): Note for managers: contractors must have a signed DPA on file *and* the attestation. Please reply with `team-name: contractor1, contractor2` in-thread so People Ops can verify.

Tom (Manager): Clarifying: are public READMEs and demo S3 buckets included in the scope?

Maya (People Ops): Yes @Tom — include public-facing docs first, then shared docs, then archived buckets. Priority order is public > shared > archive. If unsure, mark and ask in office hours.

Nora (Eng): If a repo contains only synthetic examples, do we still need to tag evidence:done?

Sam (Security): If synthetic with no real identifiers, tag `note:synthetic` and add to Evidence Vault. If mixed, scrub and upload a clean copy.

Maya (People Ops): Office hours this week: Wed 4-5pm PT & Fri 9-10am PT in #compliance-help. If you need an extension for timezone or release reasons, file a ticket at https://redwood-internal.company/it-requests with subject "attestation-extension".

ComplianceBot: Reminders scheduled: start-of-window ping, 48h reminder, 12h final reminder. :bell:

Tom (Manager): Got it, posting contractors and starting the scan now.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone 1 — well post a regional summary after each window closes.
